why: rclrs's `IntoNodeOptions::start_parameter_services` -- toggles the node's parameter services. They are a build-time capability (`param-services` / `[param_services]`), sized into the image's queryable budget, so a runtime toggle could not reclaim the slots. Absent, so a call is a compile error (`no method named `start_parameter_services``); the envelope on `rust:IntoNodeOptions` states the bound. phase-515 R2 (2026-10-27): rows filed when `IntoNodeOptions` itself was adopted, which made its members correlate.
